lessons.title: The Tool Interface
lessons.hook: The tool registry holds three fields per tool.
lessons.body: The tool registry holds four fields per tool: (1) name, (2) description, (3) schema, (4) executor reference.

lessons.title: Parallel and Streaming Tool Calls
lessons.hook: Out-of-order submission makes debugging harder; completion-order recommended.
lessons.body: Out-of-order submission makes debugging harder, but completion-order processing is recommended for UX.
